commit_message:
Fix side channel attacks in CP2

Currently, CP2 does not impose any
strict sql checks to callers allowing callers
to use malformed queries to perform side channel
attacks by parsing the return trings from the SQLite
exception thrown.

This change fixes the same by stripping SQLite error
messages when text containing "json" is present in same.
This is only done for callers without "READ_CONTACTS" as
callers with the same can anyways read the entrie cp2 db.

Bug: 465133716
Flag: EXEMPT CVE_FIX
Test: atest ContactsProviderTests
